intent: Count the reads per gene for this bacterial RNA-seq sample (single-end, aligned with Bowtie2 to the genome in aligned.bam) using genes.gtf. Only uniquely mapping reads should be counted: reads that cannot be placed at a single locus, such as those from the identical copies of the insertion element, must not contribute to any gene.
silent_error: featureCounts decides what a multi-mapping read is from the NH tag, and its banner says 'Multimapping reads : not counted'. Bowtie2 does not write an NH tag: it reports one random site for a read with several equally good sites, flagged only by a low MAPQ (0/1) and an XS:i tag. featureCounts therefore treats all of these reads as unique and counts them: the 18 reads from the three identical insertion-element copies are spread over IS200A/B/C instead of being excluded (default -Q is 0, so the MAPQ is not used). Nothing is printed about it, exit 0, Unassigned_MultiMapping stays 0. The clean run adds -Q 10, a mapping-quality filter, which is how uniqueness is enforced for aligners such as Bowtie2 that do not set NH.
